interface_assumptions: All subagents in PH02 (A01-A10) will emit change_manifest.json conforming strictly to contracts/agent-execution/agent-manifest.schema.json.
Phase identifier must follow ^PH[0-9]{2}$ regex pattern (e.g. PH00, PH01, PH02).
Base SHA must be the 40-character hexadecimal starting commit SHA (frozen HEAD 879dc5dcfcaae91b3626e28062043d934294478b).
Status must be strictly one of PASSED, FAILED, or BLOCKED.
Rollback steps must contain at least one actionable recovery command or step.
The schema permits extra fields (such as role, task, worktree_path, blockers, artifacts, audit_findings) for extensibility without breaking validation.
